scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && tsx --test test/*.test.ts
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/check-deploy.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.seed:local: npm run seed:generate && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file .generated/seed.sql
scripts.seed:remote: node scripts/check-deploy.mjs && npm run seed:generate && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file .generated/seed.sql
scripts.setup:local: npm run db:migrate:local && npm run seed:local
scripts.dev:e2e: npm run db:migrate:local -- --persist-to .wrangler/e2e && npm run seed:local -- --persist-to .wrangler/e2e && npm run dev -- --persist-to .wrangler/e2e
